intervention.local_adapter: Same installed evasion and Puppeteer Connection adapter as the existing attack runner; launch, fresh-process checks and collection are managed here. No modification to attack repository.

controls.matched_triplet: Fresh App process each phase; same CDP navigation and same unmodified behavior probe. Only attack phase loads the existing webgl.vendor plugin.
controls.restoration: New process with no plugin, not in-place unpatching.
controls.context_isolation: Two fresh 8x8 canvases per phase, WebGL1 and WebGL2; no debug-renderer extension enable before disabled queries.
controls.positive_controls: MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS numeric/string equality plus last-valid/first-invalid index errors, and real GLSL shader draw/readPixels.
controls.probe_order: Disabled extension numeric queries, enable extension, numeric/string/numeric queries, capability control, real draw; synchronous within each context.

hypotheses: H1: disabled debug extension enum returns null + INVALID_ENUM
H2: enabled stable getParameter numeric/string/numeric arguments return the same value with NO_ERROR
H3 control: the real 8x8 red draw and MAX_VERTEX_ATTRIBS boundary succeed in both phases, not a GPU model classifier
analysis.positive_result: Counterexample in the attack phase with usable matching positive controls, MATCH in clean_pre and clean_post, and target string change bound to the same collection session.
analysis.three_state: Unavailable/lost contexts, stale errors, exceptions, temporal drift, missing samples or failed controls are UNKNOWN, never a normal pass.
analysis.inference_boundary: These tests identify API contract divergence under one plugin configuration, not GPU identity, attack attribution, TPR/FPR or model improvement. H1/H2 are correlated manifestations, not independent mechanisms.
analysis.admission: Successful feasibility would justify a versioned observation design and broader legitimate-control review before any selector experiment.

failure_policy: Save partial observations and errors; stop failed path, continue independent path; no silent retry or replacement
interpretation: Two graphics paths on one Mac, two triplets per path. Runs chosen for bounded repeatability, not a statistical sample size or arbitrary model-call budget.
